## CAPS v1.0.8

### Added
- Added a liquid glass material prototype for the island and expanded panel.
- Added a round companion-only pet island for split mode.

### Changed
- Refined split/merge timing so long-left-click split feels slightly faster.
- Kept the FFT spectrum in the main island instead of moving it into the companion island.
- Updated split/merge visuals so the connector stays subtle and does not overlap the pet island.
- Made the companion island stay circular in both collapsed and expanded states.
- Replaced the startup FFT fallback color with the app's mint/green accent to avoid pink flashing.
- Improved idle island stat spacing to reduce text crowding near the FFT spectrum.
- Matched the upload arrow color with the other neutral stat arrows.

### Removed
- Removed system stats and FFT rendering from the companion island.
- Removed the trailing icon from Bilibili and YouTube URL input boxes.

## CAPS v1.0.8

### 新增
- 新增岛屿和展开面板的 Liquid Glass 材质原型。
- 新增分离模式下仅展示宠物的圆形小岛。

### 调整
- 微调分离/合并时序，让长按鼠标左键触发分离的手感更快一些。
- FFT 频谱保留在主岛中，不再移动到宠物小岛。
- 优化分离/合并视觉效果，连接部分更轻，不再覆盖宠物小岛。
- 宠物小岛在折叠和展开状态下都保持圆形。
- 将启动时 FFT 的默认颜色改为应用的薄荷绿/绿色强调色，避免出现粉色闪烁。
- 优化空闲状态下岛屿统计信息的间距，减少文字和 FFT 频谱的拥挤。
- 将上传箭头颜色调整为和其他统计箭头一致的中性色。

### 移除
- 移除宠物小岛中的系统统计和 FFT 渲染。
- 移除 Bilibili 和 YouTube URL 输入框末尾的图标。
